## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      2 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 6 авг. 2026 г. - 4 окт. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _littledudes83848_, 4 окт. 2026 г., 4/5: "It’s helpful for me, as someone with adhd, and I enjoy the customizable features that allow me to make my own goals, to do lists, day to day schedules, etc. I also enjoy being able to decorate my finches home decor and her outfits. The micropet addition really helps me keep my goals going everyday. It’s just a bit too expensive in my opinion, for the best version of the game considering how much more one can do with full access."
            2. _mysticalgamer666_, 6 авг. 2026 г., 4/5: "Makes cleaning and self care fun. The only problems i have with it is that, majority of items are either too expensive, or locked behind Finch Plus. For people like me who can’t afford £50 a year, it makes it somewhat inaccessible."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Реклама** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Реклама.**
      1 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: реклама.
      Период отзывов: 1 окт. 2026 г. - 1 окт. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи замечают давление рекламы. Это сигнал о friction в монетизации и возможном преимуществе для более чистого конкурента.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Clayer Bayer_, 1 окт. 2026 г., 5/5: "Finch is great! I love their monthly challenges that encourage you to have a little fun or reflect on the good things in life! No intrusive ads or upselling which I really appreciate. Feels very genuine. Also a nice way to connect with friends!"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      2 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 28 мая 2026 г. - 13 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _plantguyhome_, 28 мая 2026 г., 1/5: "I was so excited to use this app, even considered premium, but sadly my data gets lost every time after exiting the app for a while. This means everything is gone and I just get an apology over and over. For an app that’s meant to help people (especially ones with special conditions) this felt really frustrating to me and really killed my energy yesterday, as it has happened multiple times just yesterday. If I hatch a new pet I DON’T get the promised 500 currency + the data gets lost again. 🫤 UPDATE: Now I can’t even hatch a new egg, because the App just turns grey. Whenever I try to access the old data the screen goes white for an infinite time. So I can neither log in nor create a new one. It’s just completely broken on Iphone ig."
            2. _epicinsomniac_, 13 авг. 2026 г., 5/5: "I’ve just moved into my own place and I have a whole lot of mental issues that tend to get in the way of me hardly looking after myself. I downloaded this when I moved into my own place a few days ago and so far, I’m checking it every day, knocking off goals and getting to actually do more things for myself than I ever have before while also playing with my pet on here. I already love it even though I was truly sceptical at first."
            3. _Fliv Spencer_, 3 июн. 2026 г., 5/5: "I love this app so much. I’m on the edge of crying because they made all the pride items free for pride month. This is so fccking cute and supportive, I love it so much. It is very rare that you find an app this supportive which even lets you change everyone’s pronouns and celebrates everyone. Using the app together with friends works so well and helped so much with feeling good about yourself. The animations are incredibly cute and the app works entirely without ads and bugs, there has never been any problem with the app for me!! Thanks so much ❤️❤️❤️🌈🏳️‍⚧️"
<!--/ir-theme-->
